preconditions.description: The size of the set S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each element in the set S is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.
The elements of the set S are given in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= n <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10^6 for a_i in output_sequence))
postconditions.description: If there is no solution, the output is a single line containing -1. Otherwise, the output consists of two lines: the first line contains an integer n, and the second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (exists sequence a_1, a_2, ..., a_n such that gcd(a_i, a_{i+1}, ..., a_j) is in S for all 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ n)
postconditions.description: If there is a solution, it must produce the set S when calculating gcd(a_i, a_{i+1}, ..., a_j) for every 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ n.
